# Grace Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Origin:** Juneford  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c15 P36](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0036)</sub>
- **Titles:** daughter of our minister  <sub>[v5 c5 P1](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gracie  <sub>[v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)</sub>; Red Rose  <sub>[v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065)</sub>

## Appearance

Grace is a striking beauty with the appearance of an angel, featuring golden-brown eyes, deep red cheeks, and magnificent golden-brown ringlets. She has a turned-up nose, dimples when she smiles, and thin brown wrists. During winter, she wears a faded old gray tam.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 c4 P40](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0040), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c23 P0](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0000), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

## Personality

Grace is an outright tomboy, fearless, and full of spirit, though she is prone to fits of carelessness and impulsiveness. She possesses a cheerful, optimistic temperament with a penchant for laughter and theatrical flair. Despite her occasional brief fits of rage and private feelings of jealousy, she is deeply empathic, decisive, loyal, and stubbornly obstinate when standing up for others.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030), [v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031), [v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c5 P36](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0036), [v5 c5 P72](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0072), [v5 c5 P85](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0085), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c23 P59](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0059), [v5 c24 P11](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0011), [v5 c24 P33](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0033), [v5 c30 P1](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0001)_

## History

Grace grew up in Juneford as the daughter of Rev. John Ashdown, raising a pet rooster named Adam before her family moved to the manse at Glen St. Agnes. She became sweethearts with Cedric Stanhope, though she felt remorse when he accidentally tumbled into a spring after trying to prove his hair curled naturally. Known around the Glen for her impulsive antics, she frequently tumbled into trouble, such as spilling milk and eggs or confusing the days of the week and shaking rugs in the Methodist cemetery on a Sunday. After learning that parish dissatisfaction might force her father to leave the Glen, Grace single-handedly visited the formidable Lionel Fairlie and convinced him to return to church service. When Dan Coyle insulted her name, Edmund Carrow fought him on her behalf, wearing her blue ribbon on his arm. Following a realization that the children lacked proper guidance, Grace helped found the Good-Conduct Club alongside her siblings and friends to regulate their own behavior. She gave her shoes and cashmere stockings to poor Zilla Clow and publicly confessed her role in stealing Mr. Garrick's field potatoes to defend the innocent Lew Baxters. Later, after organizing a concert with Tobias, she faced grief and anxiety when Ida swooned from fasting and Rupert nearly died of double pneumonia. She eventually befriended Clementine Ainslie, whose bond with Grace helped encourage Rev.
